title: Capstone deliverables
prompt: Recall the core stages of the capstone.
solution: Question, clean/validate, analyze, visualize, and communicate via a findings memo with limitations.
front: What are the five key deliverables of an end-to-end analytics capstone?
back: Clear question, documented data cleaning, grouped/statistical analysis, labeled charts, and a BLUF findings memo with limitations.

title: Why state limitations
prompt: Recall why limitations belong in every analysis.
solution: Prevents overclaiming and documents sample/measurement boundaries honestly.
front: Why should every analytics memo include a Limitations section?
back: It prevents stakeholders from over-generalizing results beyond what the data supports and builds trust.
